lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Mr. Commander.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Mr. Commander.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Mr. Commaaanderrrrrr!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: BOOM!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: BOOM! BOOM!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
You scared me there for a sec!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe! Heya, Mr. Commander!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I'm Elegg.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I'm from the Electric Shock Squad.
I remember.
Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I know that you work with a whole bunch of different Nikkes,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: so I thought I'd remind you just in case you might forget :3

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You forgot, didn't you?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Well, I guess that makes sense,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: considering how many Nikkes you work with.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Just thought I'd drop a reminder in case it slipped your mind, hehe.
You contacted me just to tell me that?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Nope, that's not even close!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I re-read some old BOOM comics today, and I've gotta say,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: BOOM Guy is such a hottie!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: No one around me is familiar with that game though,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I wanted to share it with you!
I didn't know there was a BOOM comic series.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: There certainly is!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's all about BOOM Guy wielding a massive arsenal to defeat his enemies.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The books may be short, but they're packed with exciting scenes!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: They're so immersive too!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It's honestly hard to describe in words.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Where are you now, Mr. Commander?
I'm in my room.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Sweet, I'll come over right now!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I can tell you all about the BOOM comics!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: You've really gotta check them out!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Trust me, you'll be totally hooked!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hang on, I'll be there in a jiffy!
Before I can turn Elegg down, she has already stopped reading messages.
